stories.title: Demolition of historic Masonic Temple underway in downtown Knoxville
stories.summary: Demolition crews dismantle Knoxville's historic Masonic Temple despite failed preservation efforts.

stories.title: TDEC gives out $38.4M in low-interest loans for water infrastructure projects across the state
stories.summary: Tennessee is boosting its water infrastructure with $38.4 million in low-interest loans for projects across seven communities.

stories.title: Type One Energy, UT's Tickle College of Engineering to receive first-of-its-kind grant for collaborative fusion research
stories.summary: Gov. Bill Lee and Deputy Gov. Stuart McWhorter announced on Monday that they would receive the IRIS grant to support industry-led research.

stories.title: KCSO says man died at hospital after barricading himself inside vehicle on Northshore Drive
stories.summary: The Knox County Sheriff's Office provided conflicting messages on the man's status before saying he was pronounced dead.

stories.title: Fantasy of Trees prepares for 42nd year while raising money for Children's Hospital
stories.summary: The 42nd annual Fantasy of Trees returns to the Knoxville Convention Center Nov. 25-29, with a goal of raising $2 million for Dolly Parton Children's Hospital.

stories.title: Jefferson Co. Sheriff's Office crime suppression unit reports 14 arrests after 2-day enforcement event
stories.summary: The 'IMPACT Crime Suppression Unit' launched in the summer of 2026 as a proactive approach to targeting crime.

stories.title: Non-alcoholic bar in Maryville announces closure
stories.summary: Daisy's NA Bar and Bottle Shop said the last day it will be open is Dec. 23 and will keep regular hours until then.

stories.title: Firefighters rescue four dogs from house fire in northwest Knoxville
stories.summary: The Knoxville Fire Department said no people were home at the time of the fire, but four dogs were found safe.

stories.title: East Tennessee woman seeks to turn dreams into reality on her third trip to American Idol
stories.summary: Carie Ferra, also known as the singing waitress, has now auditioned for American Idol three times. She's hoping her third time's the charm.

stories.title: Pigeon Forge's 'Country Tonite Theatre' to close after 30 seasons; owner cites leadership changes
stories.summary: In an announcement on Saturday, leaders said they decided to conclude operations at the end of the year rather than transition to new management.

stories.title: DA: Blount County man sentenced to over a decade in prison for 2025 crash that killed 31-year-old
stories.summary: Ronald Morgan Weaver Jr. was sentenced to 11.5 years on Nov. 20 for vehicular homicide and driving while impaired, the DA said.

stories.title: Greene County fire 100% contained at 1,875 acres, officials say
stories.summary: The Tennessee Department of Forestry provided an update Sunday morning, four days after the fire started.
